source: curved-annulus-32.stl after native selected-inner smoothing at 100 percent; native export saved separately
operation: Edit scan / Boundaries / 3D Sketch from all, fit tolerance 0.05 mm, then 3D Sketch edit / Export in IGES
observations: One sketch object and one history entry contained two boundary curves.
IGES contains two type 126 cubic B-spline entities.
The source is the smoothed control, not the original annulus.
This observation does not establish spatial-curve editing or application parity.

originalSelectedControl.operation: From fresh original mesh, select inner boundary with next; 3D Sketch from selected at 0.05 mm; edit sketch and export IGES

originalOuterControls.description: Original outer boundary selected; tolerance typed explicitly and committed by tab before 3D Sketch from selected.

toleranceInterpretation.nativeStaticScope: The boundary-sketch helper passes tolerance into the adaptive cubic builder. Its returned record contains mean error at offset 8 and maximum error at offset 16; candidate admission compares tolerance to the offset-8 value. Refinement uses offset 16.
toleranceInterpretation.independentNativeControls: Outer boundary entered at 0.05 and 0.001 mm; IGES spline knots and poles are retained below.
toleranceInterpretation.limitation: The measured selected and all controls do not establish general native 3D sketch editor behavior.

meanErrorCorrection.red: Using maximum error produced eight poles on the 0.05 mm outer control; native exported seven.
meanErrorCorrection.green: Mean-error candidate admission matches retained 0.05 and 0.001 mm outer controls and both curves from the smoothed control to IGES precision.
meanErrorCorrection.focusedTests: 111 tests in nine files, including native smoothing and the shared MCP worker path, passed under the 4 GiB guard.
meanErrorCorrection.renderedGui: On a separate 5175 tab, imported 64-facet annulus and Smooth all completed with one history step; no browser warnings or errors.
meanErrorCorrection.limitations: This does not implement or validate spatial-sketch publication or its editor; full M2 native and public-MCP acceptance remain open.
